description: Onset spread across the filterbank with and without whole-path group-delay compensation (D24). SPEC section 3 requires the residual to be quoted alongside any T3 result taken with compensation on, so it is recorded as data rather than left in a notebook entry.

stimulus.comment: Matches test_F6: a unit impulse at n//3 of a 1 s buffer. Broadband, so every channel is excited identically and the spread of envelope peaks is the channel-dependent lag alone.

seed_comment: The stimulus and the whole path are deterministic, so the three-seed rule in CLAUDE.md does not apply here — there is nothing for a seed to vary. Recorded as 0 for the manifest.
